minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  May 24, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:44 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Staff Present:  Anna Ma, Police Department
  Stephanie Maldonado
  Angela Williams

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of April 26, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Joe Schutte Complete Pool and Spa – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing pool maintenance services at all parks in the amount of $7,000.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

3. Adlerhorst International, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  training for Canines in the Police Department in the amount of $4,520.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

4. Medico Healthcare Linen Service – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing linen services to the Jail Facility in the Police Department in the amount of $3,148.90.
  Motion carried unanimously.

5. Botach Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing supplies for the
  Police Department in the amount of $4,702.50. Motion carried unanimously.

6. Electronic Waste Solictions – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  services of debris removal and encampment cleanups the amount of $7,499.50. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:54 a.m. Adjournment
